==About me==

''Hay! ''So I'm Healbatto, HB, and I'm a big fan of the WoT and only recently found this wiki. I am a writer, specifically focusing on screenplays, but I find reading WoT some of the best help to any writer.

I originally found WoT while looking for a series that was longer than LotR. I found LotR interesting, but too short. I was asking around for a while and one of my friends told me WoT would be the perfect series. It was. I am a giant fan boy now and I look forward to contributing to the site.
